evidence.claim: When a queued slashing is finalized after the target vault's totalAssets has dropped to zero (via another DSS slash or completed withdrawals), Vault.slashAssets computes transferAmount=0 and calls SlashingHandler.handleSlashing, which reverts on ZeroAmount, reverting the whole finalizeSlashing and blocking slashing of the other vaults in the same request.
evidence.support_reason: Vault.slashAssets (src/Vault.sol:193-205) sets transferAmount = Math.min(totalAssets(), totalAssetsToSlash) with no zero guard, then unconditionally calls ISlashingHandler(slashingHandler).handleSlashing(IERC20(asset()), transferAmount) at line 202. SlashingHandler.handleSlashing (src/SlashingHandler.sol:52-59) reverts with ZeroAmount() at line 53 when amount==0. SlasherLib.finalizeSlashing (src/entities/SlasherLib.sol:126-151) loops over all queuedSlashing.vaults (line 134) and calls slashAssets without try/catch, so one zero-asset vault reverts the entire finalizeSlashing. The path is reachable: requestSlashing (Core.sol:220) is callable by a registered DSS, earmarkedStakes are snapshotted at request time (SlasherLib.sol:79-92), and the veto window (SlasherLib.sol:129) plus permissionless finalizeSlashing (Core.sol:248) allow the vault balance to change in between. No check elsewhere prevents totalAssets from reaching zero before finalization.
preconditions: DSS registered and operator registered to it with >=2 vaults staked
A queued slashing covering multiple vaults
One covered vault's totalAssets becomes 0 before finalizeSlashing (other DSS slash or completed redeem)
